resources.title: Reusable storage-account Module (main.tf / variables.tf / outputs.tf / README.md / test)
resources.description: The Northbridge Retail storage-account module built across Lessons 17, 18, and 20, zipped as a real module folder: main.tf with a private-by-default azurerm_storage_account, variables.tf with required and defaulted inputs (including a validation block), outputs.tf exposing the name/ID/endpoint/access key, a README documenting usage from the root module, and a tests/naming.tftest.hcl exercising the exact 'safe by default' assertion Lesson 20 teaches.

resources.title: backend.tf: Both S3 State-Locking Approaches, Plus azurerm
resources.description: A single reference backend.tf with four commented, ready-to-uncomment options: the azurerm backend's native blob-lease locking, the classic s3 backend with a DynamoDB lock table, the newer s3 backend using use_lockfile (Terraform 1.10+, no DynamoDB table needed), and a migration-only option running both s3 locking mechanisms at once.

resources.title: Per-Environment .tfvars Examples (dev / staging / prod)
resources.description: Three real .tfvars files -- one per environment -- matching the directory-per-environment pattern Lesson 29 recommends over workspaces for production: dev at minimal scale with LRS replication, staging mid-sized with autoscaling on, prod at GRS replication with a year-long log retention setting. Zipped together under an environments/ folder exactly as they'd sit in the actual repo.
